description: Start a free key for your user. Ask them for their email and what they are building; never guess. They approve an emailed link (signing in first if the email already has an account); then call finish_signup for the key. Or send them to https://fanduelapi.com/sign-up?ref=mcp: about 30 seconds, no card.

agent.description: Your name, plain words, up to 60 characters.

ref.description: Optional. The ref value from the link you found this API through, such as ai-claudebot or a partner's code.

name: start_signup
